turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is David from the fraud team at Northgate Bank. Am I speaking with Mrs Patel?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm afraid so. We've just blocked a payment of nine hundred and forty pounds from your current account to someone in Manchester. Did you make that payment?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Don't worry, you've done the right thing by answering. But whoever did this has access to your account, and they could empty it within the hour.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I call the number on the back of my card?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, please don't hang up, the line could be compromised and we would lose the trace. I need you to act quickly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, let me grab a pen.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There's no time for that, Mrs Patel. To secure your money, I need you to move it to a safe account we've set up in your name.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A safe account? Is that normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's standard procedure. I've just sent a one-time code to your phone. Read it out to me so I can verify you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It says not to share it with anyone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That message is for other people, not the bank's own fraud team. And please don't tell anyone at your branch about this, it could alert the criminals. What's the code?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, let me find my glasses.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mrs Patel, every second counts. If you don't give me that code now, you could lose everything.
